m.aarti.pad1: Victory to you, abode of all that is auspicious, remover of the world's burden, Śiva, foe of Tripura, embodied in a monkey's form. You are the garland of flames from the fire of Śrī Rāma's wrath, and in that guise you destroy the moths that are the demons who roam in darkness.
m.aarti.pad2: Victory to you, home of the joy of the Wind-god and Añjanā, sole friend in the sorrow of Sugrīva when his head was bowed. To the arrogant demons you are Rudra, the angry fire of doom; to siddhas, gods and the good you are an ocean of joy.
m.aarti.pad3: Victory to you, foremost of the Rudras, foremost of those the world reveres, world-famed emperor of warriors; foremost of the singers of the Sāmaveda, foremost of those who have conquered desire; devoted to Śrī Rāma's good, you follow and stand by Śrī Rāma's devotees.
m.aarti.pad4: Victory to you, victorious in battle, bearer of Śrī Rāma's message, who told Kosala of his welfare and well-being. To Bharata and the other men and women, scorched by the sun of separation from Śrī Rāma, you are the wish-granting tree that brings coolness.
m.aarti.pad5: Victory to you: seeing Śrī Rāma, Sītā's beloved, seated on the throne, you dance in overflowing joy. With Śrī Rāma, radiant in his splendour, you ever roam in the Rāma-city of Tulasī's mind.
